newsitem.title: USA: Dell names Gesmar-Larsen regional president.
newsitem.headline: Dell names Gesmar-Larsen regional president.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp said Thursday it named Jan Gesmar-Larsen president of its Europe, Middle East and Africa regions.
The company said Gesmar-Larsen succeeds Martyn Ratcliffe, who will be leaving to pursue a personal interest in managing corporate turnaround and entrepreneurial opportunities.
The company said Gesmar-Larsen was previously president of the Europe, Middle East and Africa regions for Apple Computer Inc.
Dell said Gesmar-Larsen will join the company in August and report to the office of the chief executive.
